title: Kevolt SmartValue Modbus proxy capture
summary: The sanitized proxy trace contains repeated CRC-valid FC03 exchanges at slave 1. Identity reads return device type 5, protocol version 0x0104, and rated-power words 0x3880/0x0001. Runtime reads cover status, energy, battery, three-phase grid/load/generator, and four PV inputs in the 500-683 range.
